- Build a complete, playable 2D Celeste-style climbing game with dash and wall-jump across five screens.

- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finished.

- Implemented a standalone HTML canvas game with five climbing rooms, keyboard and touch controls, checkpoints, hazards, and a summit ending.
